title: Reconciliation of lower-node, bottom-face and legacy z(NN+1) branch semantics
source_findings: Legacy mode-1 counts nodes while grid_z(NN+1)>gwlinp and then reads grid_z(NN+1) again to decide inside-profile versus below-profile behavior.
The modern explicit geometry contract and FSI04 test stubs expose z with exactly n node centres; they do not expose an n+1 z sentinel.
Therefore the historical value and ownership of grid_z(numnod+1) are not recoverable from the admitted typed geometry surface.
The legacy source alone does not provide sufficient typed authority to classify a groundwater level between the last node centre and the declared bottom face.

contract_inconsistency.candidate_contract: classifies below-profile using declared bottom-face geometry
contract_inconsistency.state_contract: uses BELOW_BOTTOM_NODE when all node centres are above H_phreatic, including the -275 cm example
contract_inconsistency.consequence: LOW01-C cannot use both policies as if they were the same source fact.

typed_research_policy.below_profile_live_slice: For LOW01-A/A2/D, require H_phreatic < declared bottom_face and use the exact derived mode-5 hbot mapping. This slice is already source-safe without any z(n+1) assumption.
typed_research_policy.inside_profile_live_slice: For LOW01-B, restrict H_phreatic to cases that leave at least one declared node centre below the groundwater level (the preregistered -60/-120/-200 cm cases).
typed_research_policy.unresolved_half_cell: The interval bottom_face < H_phreatic <= bottom_node_center is a distinct geometry-policy gap. Do not classify it as source-equivalent inside-profile or below-profile behavior until an explicit typed policy is derived.
typed_research_policy.low01c_rule: LOW01-C must characterize internal-node snap boundaries independently from the lower-half-cell/bottom-face policy. The latter remains a separate unresolved boundary-policy slice.

effects: LOW01-A, LOW01-A2 and LOW01-D are unaffected because their H_phreatic is below -300 cm.
LOW01-B preregistered cases are unaffected because all lie above the bottom node centre and strictly inside the declared node domain.
The existing STATE01 -275 cm BELOW_BOTTOM_NODE case is retained only as a typed branch-classifier experiment, not as source-equivalent legacy mode-1 evidence.
HLINK04 remains blocked until the lower-half-cell policy is explicitly resolved or excluded from its admitted envelope.
forbidden: do not invent a historical z(numnod+1) value
do not silently equate bottom node centre and bottom face
do not use the -275 cm STATE01 case as proof of legacy source semantics
no production mode-1 admission from this reconciliation
next: Preregister LOW01-C1 for internal-node snap boundaries using only source-safe inside-profile cases.
Preregister LOW01-C2 separately for bottom-node/bottom-face policy after an explicit geometric semantics decision.
